summary: Nissan Auto Receivables Company II LLC filed an 8-K reporting an ordinary auto-loan securitization. On September 30, 2026, depositor NARC II acquired retail installment contracts from sponsor/servicer Nissan Motor Acceptance Company, then transferred them to Nissan Auto Receivables 2026-B Owner Trust, a Delaware statutory trust. Closing-date documents include the Purchase Agreement, Amended and Restated Trust Agreement, Sale and Servicing Agreement, and Asset Representations Review Agreement with Clayton Fixed Income Services. No equity stake, price per share, premium, or board recommendation appears. This is a routine term ABS issuance, so the risk-arb angle is limited to deal-execution and credit performance monitoring.
